row.title: Smoke runway check reads runway_days and meets_target
row.body: The production smoke test read a key the runway record never had, so the runway check failed on every run. It now reads runway_days, meets_target, below and unmeasured. land_data starts no checks run on a data branch: a dispatched run does not satisfy the branch rule.

title: Smoke runway check reads runway_days and meets_target
